title: Dear Grandma
text:
Dear Grandma,

Thank you for the lovely birthday present! I love the red scarf. It is soft and warm. I wore it to school today, and my friend Sari said it was very nice. Everyone asked me where I got it.

I am eight now. We had a small party at home. Mum made a big chocolate cake, and we played games in the garden. I wish you were here.

Please come and visit us soon. I will show you my new bike.

Love from,
Nadia
